topic_en: Compute the double integral of x times y over the triangular region where x ranges from zero to one and y ranges from zero to x. First, draw the triangular region on a 2D coordinate plane and shade it. Second, set up the iterated integral with outer integral over x from zero to one and inner integral over y from zero to x. Third, integrate with respect to y to get x times y squared over two evaluated from zero to x, which equals x cubed over two. Fourth, integrate the result with respect to x to get x to the fourth over eight, evaluated from zero to one. Fifth, simplify to get the final answer one over eight.
